title: The Cauchy problem for the generalized KdV equation in the Sobolev space $H^{s}(\mathbf{R})$
summary: In this paper, we are concerned with the Cauchy problem for the generalized KdV equation with random data and rough data. Firstly, when $s\in\mathbf{R}$, by using the initial value randomization technique introduced by Shen et al. (arXiv:2111.11935) and the construction of appropriate auxiliary spaces, we establish the almost sure local well-posedness of the generalized KdV equation in $H^{s}(\mathbf{R})$, which improves Theorem 1.3 of Hwang and Kwak (Proc.
